title: Interpreting Diffusion Model Activations in Natural Language
abstract: arXiv:2611.28621v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interpreting the intermediate activations of diffusion models (DMs) is key to understanding how they generate images. Existing interpretability methods for DMs provide limited support for open-ended interrogation, making it difficult to extract human-interpretable insights. We extend LatentQA, the task of answering natural-language questions about Large Language Model activations, to DM activations. We introduce the Diffusion-specific Activation Oracle (DAO), which translates DM activations into natural-language answers to open-ended questions about the ongoing generation. Our experiments show that DAO can effectively describe the content of the final image from activations at early denoising steps. Additionally, we demonstrate that DAO captures the structure of the DM's activation space well enough to steer image generation toward target attributes. translated_title: 用自然语言解释扩散模型激活
translated_abstract: 解释扩散模型（DM）的中间激活是理解其图像生成机制的关键。现有的扩散模型可解释性方法对开放式提问的支持有限，难以提取人类可理解的洞见。我们将LatentQA——回答关于大语言模型激活的自然语言问题的任务——扩展到了扩散模型激活领域。我们提出了扩散专用激活预言机，它将扩散模型的激活转换为自然语言答案，用以回答关于正在进行中的生成过程的开放式问题。实验表明，DAO能够从早期去噪步骤的激活中有效描述最终图像的内容。此外，我们证明DAO能够充分捕捉扩散模型激活空间的结构，足以引导图像生成朝向目标属性。进一步地，我们展示了通过DAO进行归因修补可以识别扩散模型中……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出扩散专用激活预言机（DAO），能将扩散模型中间激活翻译为自然语言回答开放式问题，既可从早期去噪步骤预测最终图像内容，又能利用激活空间结构引导生成目标属性并定位关键模型组件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Diffusion-specific Activation Oracle (DAO), which translates diffusion model activations into natural-language answers to open-ended questions, enabling prediction of final image content from early denoising steps, steering generation toward target attributes, and identifying key model components.
